## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Kuṇḍapūvajātaka* (Ja 109) is a canonical birth story located in the Jātaka section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The narrative opens with the verse phrase “As fares his worshipper” and was delivered by the Buddha while residing at Sāvatthī in reference to an impoverished man [SuttaCentral]. The Jātaka has been translated into English under the title *The Cake* [SuttaCentral].
